# Lucide Poster Studio

> Artisanal Grid Composition & High-Resolution Vector Poster Engine powered by 1,779+ official Lucide vector icons.

## Main Application

- [Studio App](https://serene-margulis.82-223-216-124.plesk.page/studio): Interactive poster studio canvas and design workspace
- [Landing Page](https://serene-margulis.82-223-216-124.plesk.page/): Product overview, features, and poster showcase

## Documentation & Repository

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/martinproject/lucide-poster-studio): Official open-source project repository
- [Lucide Icons](https://lucide.dev): Official Lucide iconography catalog and guides
- [Lucide License](https://lucide.dev/license): ISC License terms for Lucide icons

## Capabilities & Tools

- [Vector SVG Export](https://serene-margulis.82-223-216-124.plesk.page/studio): Clean SVG vector output with named layer tags for Figma and Illustrator
- [Print-Ready PDF](https://serene-margulis.82-223-216-124.plesk.page/studio): 300 DPI CMYK PDF export with bleed and crop registration marks
- [3D Spatial Mockups](https://serene-margulis.82-223-216-124.plesk.page/studio): Interior gallery simulation with oak, aluminum, and glass frames
